question: How are the mantra syllables to be contemplated in relation to consciousness power?
premises: The mantra syllables are the objects of contemplation.
They are described as strung upon the power of consciousness.
Contemplation of this relation is prescribed.
inference: Therefore one should contemplate the mantra syllables as threaded upon the power of consciousness.
plain_english: One should contemplate the mantra syllables as strung upon the power of consciousness.
